comparability_note: Fiscal year ends on 30 June; additions include facilities data centres and computer systems and are not issuer-labelled AI capex.
The issuer separately describes capital expenditures as primarily technical infrastructure and office facilities; do not treat the full amount as AI-only spend.
The raw cash-flow line is used for cross-company screening; Amazon's own free-cash-flow measure nets property-sale proceeds and incentives.
The raw cash-flow line excludes principal payments on finance leases; Meta reports a broader capital-expenditure amount that includes both.
